kenjudy-pdca-agentic-coding-framework-pd.description: Guides developers through a human-supervised PDCA framework for AI code generation. Applies analysis, TDD, validation, and retrospection. Activates for sessions requiring systematic quality control.

kenjudy-pdca-agentic-coding-framework-up.description: Updates a project changelog with entries for changes since the branch diverged from main. Use when about to open a PR, cutting a release, or when the user asks about changelog, release notes, or migration notes.
